model_choice: Exact MCLP with Coverage Indicators. For ~24 candidate sites and ~24 demand points, we have 48 binary variables. This is well within the CGA backend limit of ~3,600 variables. The formulation uses standard linear constraints for coverage logic, which are converted to QUBO penalties by the backend solver infrastructure.

sites.meaning: Candidate locations for charging stations (district centers)

demands.meaning: Districts to be covered (same set as sites in this specific problem context)

k.meaning: Number of charging stations to select

data_found: 臺北市各里人口數按年齡分_CSV.csv

prep.notes: Filtered population data to latest period (110年), total gender (計), and village level. Filtered boundary data to Da'an District. Converted TWD97 projected coordinates to WGS84 lat/lon. Merged duplicate boundary rows per village. Joined population and boundary data on village name to form the final set of sites/demands with coordinates and population.
